statement: Let n = len(price). For any subset S of {0,1,...,n-1} with |S| = k, define tastiness(S) = min { |price[i] - price[j]| : i, j in S and i != j }. The function returns a result r such that r = max { tastiness(S) : S is a subset of {0,...,n-1} with |S| = k }.
preconditions: len(price) >= 2; 2 <= k <= len(price); len(price) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(price), 1 <= price[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail due to overflow, out-of-bounds access, or panic.
preconditions: len(price) >= 2; 2 <= k <= len(price); len(price) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(price), 1 <= price[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r >= 0.

statement: The function returns a result r and r <= max_{0 <= i < len(price)} price[i] - min_{0 <= i < len(price)} price[i].
preconditions: len(price) >= 2; 2 <= k <= len(price); len(price) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(price), 1 <= price[i] <= 1000000000.

preconditions: len(price) >= 2; 2 <= k <= len(price); len(price) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(price), 1 <= price[i] <= 1000000000.

preconditions: len(price) >= 2; 2 <= k <= len(price); len(price) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(price), 1 <= price[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and for every integer d >= 0, r >= d if and only if there exists a subset S of {0,1,...,len(price)-1} with |S| = k such that for all i, j in S with i != j, |price[i] - price[j]| >= d.
preconditions: len(price) >= 2; 2 <= k <= len(price); len(price) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(price), 1 <= price[i] <= 1000000000.

preconditions: len(price) >= 2; 2 <= k <= len(price); len(price) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(price), 1 <= price[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 0 if and only if the number of distinct values among price[0], ..., price[len(price)-1] is less than k.

statement: Let s be the nondecreasing rearrangement of price, i.e., s[0] <= s[1] <= ... <= s[len(price)-1] and the multiset {s[0], ..., s[len(price)-1]} equals the multiset {price[0], ..., price[len(price)-1]}. The function returns a result r and r = max { min_{t=1}^{k-1} (s[i_{t+1}] - s[i_t]) : 0 <= i_1 < i_2 < ... < i_k < len(price) }.
preconditions: len(price) >= 2; 2 <= k <= len(price); len(price) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(price), 1 <= price[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r. For every permutation pi of the index set {0,1,...,len(price)-1}, let q be the array with q[i] = price[pi(i)] for 0 <= i < len(price). Then the maximum tastiness for q (with the same k) is also r.
preconditions: len(price) >= 2; 2 <= k <= len(price); len(price) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(price), 1 <= price[i] <= 1000000000.
